prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the long reflecting pool path in front of the Taj Mahal with pale marble paving, a waist-high ornamental rail and low steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult American woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on rose-gold chain (a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a copper barrel-shaped weight, a copper small flared temple bell, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a bronze cube-shaped block, a gold miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating floral border filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Colombian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, smooth golden-tan skin, a bright open smile showing his teeth, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large silver hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver ship's anchor, a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver ring. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense folk-art floral motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands on his hips, elbows out.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
